races.title: State Senate, District 3
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Bob Brinson
cands.bio: Republican state senator for District 3 (Beaufort, Craven and Lenoir counties), first appointed in July 2024. Retired Army lieutenant colonel after 28 years as a helicopter pilot, logistician and Inspector General. West Point graduate. Elected New Bern alderman in 2022 and served as Mayor Pro Tem in 2023.
cands.gaps: We found no documented positions from Brinson on data centers, development or growth, homestead property taxes, foreign or investor land buying, or H-1B and immigration enforcement. No bills he sponsored were listed in the pages we could read, so we could not show deeds on any issue. His stated positions come only from his campaign website, and he did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2024 or 2026. His platform does not mention teacher pay. We found no controversies and no endorsements reported for him. His birthplace and upbringing rest on his own campaign statement, with no independent source.

local.label: Roots 100: His campaign site says he is a New Bern native who graduated from New Bern Senior High School and returned to make New Bern home after his Army career; this is self-reported.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: State senator since July 2024; elected New Bern alderman in 2022 and chosen Mayor Pro Tem in 2023; 28-year Army officer (aviator, logistician, Inspector General, Lt. Col.); Master of Public Administration.
qual.why: He has prior legislative service in the state Senate plus local elected office. His Army logistics and Inspector General work, along with a public administration degree, are relevant to policy and budget work.

cands.name: Charles Dudley
cands.bio: Retired Marine with 22 years of service, including Desert Storm/Desert Shield, and a minister for 22 years. Lives in Havelock, NC. Tax commissioner for Harlowe Fire Department and a three-term 1st Vice President of the Craven County Democratic Party. Ran for NC Senate District 3 in 2024 and 2026.

endorsements.text: Listed by Ballotpedia as recommended in 2026 by three Sway voter-guide groups: 'Reject AIPAC from City Council to Congress' (Vote for Peace), 'Unburdening The Ballot: Voting Made Easy' (Tevin Davis) and 'Waves of Democracy' (Terri Robinson). These are voter-guide recommendations, not organizational endorsements.

cands.gaps: We couldn't find where Dudley was raised or the year he moved to North Carolina. We found no record of any legislative office or of work on law or the budget. We found no bills, official actions or filings on data centers, property taxes, land ownership, growth, immigration, policing, guns, or schools. His only stated position on our topics is on abortion. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2024 or 2026 candidate surveys, and his 2018 survey answers did not address these topics. We found no stated positions on data centers or development, and no news coverage of controversies or foreign ties.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.
score.why_money: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: 22 years in the Marine Corps and 22 years as a minister. He is a tax commissioner for Harlowe Fire Department and has been a party officer (Craven County Democratic Party 1st Vice President). He has held no legislative office, and he lost the 2018 House District 3 Democratic primary and the 2024 NC Senate District 3 general election.
qual.why: He has no legislative, policy or budget career in the record. The only office listed is a local fire-department tax commissioner, and the page doesn't say whether it is elected. His board seats and party offices don't count. His military and ministry work is mostly unrelated to writing law and budgets.
